scope: independent source and real filesystem fault-test review

findings_resolved.finding: Atomic helper default 0600 changed existing and creation permissions
findings_resolved.resolution: Opt-in preservation of existing user/group/other permission bits and 0666 creation mode subject to umask

findings_resolved.finding: Special permission bits should not be restored for JSON recordings

limits: Atomic publication is not a multi-writer lock; concurrent writers can still overwrite each other's history.
Existing final read-error handling is unchanged; bounded Windows sharing retry does not guarantee recovery from a permanent lock.
